bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are permitted after search; backpacks are not. Medical-device carriers larger than that limit can be admitted following inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The arena publishes parking and access information on its dedicated parking page; check the event listing for the applicable lot and price.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The arena’s FAQ and parking page do not set out a dedicated rideshare pickup area for all shows.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession and merchandise stands are cashless. Outside food and beverages are prohibited except medically needed food and drinks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The arena publishes a separate accessibility guide and provides guest service locations on its concourses for assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests cannot leave and use the same ticket to return, except in medical or emergency situations.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The arena has an Ascension St. Vincent’s Box Office and Will Call; refer to its box-office page or the concert ticket confirmation for show-day pickup details.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Bags are searched at entry, including medical-device carriers. Check the concert event page for exact opening time and entrance.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
